notes: The partner adult day health care center (public/models/seen-partner-adhc.json). Everyone is a scene person: twenty-six participants keep their own places at the two long tables all day (partner-tables, no interaction) and leave them for the morning rotation (calligraphy in the studio, a class in the classroom, group therapy in the group room), painting, the line dance, light rehab with the visiting Seen PT, the choir on the stage, bingo, the afternoon studio and the fan dance.
Points are in the facility plan frame P; heading h faces (sin h, cos h): 0 faces +z (the drive and the long tables), 3.1416 faces the stage.

Walking performers reach the stage by its steps, walkers and wheelchairs by the ramp. The choir arrives back tier first and files off a tier at a time, front tier first and each east to west once the tier in front is clear; the dance rows arrive back row first and leave front row first, so nobody passes between people already in place.

Dancers stand 1.65 m apart in staggered rows, just outside the touchpoint trace’s 1.6 m encounter radius; the audiences at the tables are not interaction members, so the trace stays under its size bound.
